summary: This well-positioned apartment is located in the heart of the West End of Darlington, within easy walking distance of the town centre, offering a vibrant mix of cafes, shops, restaurants, and bars.
description:
The property is also conveniently close to local amenities, including schools, transport links, the train station, and a supermarket, providing both practicality and accessibility for everyday living. The apartment is ideal for investors, with the potential to achieve a rental income of over £550 per calendar month. The accommodation briefly comprises a welcoming entrance hall, a landing, a spacious lounge, a fitted kitchen, a comfortable bedroom, and a family bathroom, all offering a practical and adaptable living space. Externally, there is a garden area to the front of the property, offering a pleasant outdoor space. The apartment is offered with vacant possession and no onward chain, allowing for a straightforward purchase. Early viewings are highly recommended to fully appreciate the location, layout, and potential this property has to offer.

ENTRANCE HALL The entrance hall is accessed through a sturdy wooden entrance door and offers a bright and welcoming entry point to the property. Stairs lead to the first floor, providing access to the main living areas.

LANDING AREA The first floor landing is well-lit by a UPVC-framed double-glazed window, creating a bright and welcoming space. A radiator provides warmth, and doors lead off to all rooms, offering practical access throughout the apartment.

LOUNGE /DINING ROOM The lounge/dining room is a well-proportioned and inviting space, flooded with natural light from a UPVC-framed double-glazed window to the front aspect. The room features a radiator for comfort, a built-in storage cupboard, and ample space to comfortably accommodate a dining table and chairs, creating a versatile living and entertaining area.

KITCHEN The kitchen features a modern range of base and wall units with laminate work surfaces and tiled splashbacks, providing both style and practicality. An inset sink unit with drainer and mixer tap is complemented by plumbing for an automatic washing machine, with additional space for a fridge and cooker. Natural light floods the room through a UPVC-framed double-glazed window, and a radiator ensures comfort, making this a bright and highly functional kitchen space.

BEDROOM This spacious bedroom is bright and airy, with a UPVC-framed double-glazed window allowing natural light to flood the space. The room is further enhanced by a radiator and a range of fitted three-door wardrobes, offering practical storage solutions and a tidy, organised appearance.

FAMILY BATHROOM The family bathroom features a modern white suite, including a double shower cubicle with an inset electric shower, wash hand basin, and low-level WC. Tiling to the splashback and vanity areas adds both style and practicality, while a radiator ensures comfort, creating a bright and functional bathroom space.

EXTERNALLY The property benefits from a front garden laid to lawn, offering a pleasant and low-maintenance outdoor area which complements the exterior and creates an inviting first impression.
